errors.text: The proposed intervention is an unspecified class—introducing an arbitrary secondary phase or precipitates by unspecified alloying or processing—rather than a single reproducible intervention such as Ti addition with rapid quenching to stabilize an fcc–C14 dual phase.

The requirement that saturation magnetization not be significantly compromised conflicts with the target mechanism, in which antiferromagnetic coupling involving Ti reduces saturation magnetization while enabling the high-coercivity state.
